route_chain_id_encoding: ASCII BNBMAIN plus profile version 1, interpreted as uint64

adapter.required_finality: BnbConsensusLightClient420 two linked BSC mainnet BLS quorum certificates

activation_requirements: BridgeChainRegistry420 entry uses route_chain_id and canonical BNB Smart Chain mainnet identity
production IBnbFinalityVerifier420 implementation is deployed and reviewed
canonical BNB gateway contract is governance allowlisted
BNB native source mapping is bound to the canonical BNB bridge asset id
every BEP-20 token is explicitly source-token mapped before qualification
each asset id is bound to an active BridgeRouteRegistry route
route risk caps and emergency isolation are configured
end-to-end inbound and outbound qualification passes
bep20_policy: Default deny. A mapping and route alone are insufficient. The Bridge asset registry must independently qualify a canonical token profile; no BEP-20 profile is currently supported by the authoritative launch catalogue.
security_invariants: wrong EIP-155 chain id fails closed
unapproved native/BEP-20 source asset fails closed
direct adapter calls bypassing GatewayRouter420 fail closed
outbound recipients must be exactly 20 bytes

local_verifier.profile: BSC mainnet Maxwell-and-later, epoch length 1000, address-sorted BLS rosters, authenticated delayed epoch transitions
local_verifier.operational_cost: Software BLS is expensive: thousands of progress calls and approximately 41-45 billion gas per certificate; retain inactive route pending deployment configuration.
